spans.text: M99 reporting in! M99 reporting in!
Sangvis Ringleader Hunter has emerged near the command post. Would all teams please accelerate your search progress.
So M99 is the T-Doll in charge of the search...
P08, what's your method of searching for the Sangvis transmission device?
The transmission signal is encrypted with some new tech and can only be detected in close proximity.
So all we can do for now is conduct a blanket search and hope we get lucky.
I know it's insanely dangerous, but there's no other way.
Humph. Which is why...you'd better make it less dangerous for us.
